title: Wear : Data layer foreground notification
symptom: On the latest dev build, a persistent 'Data layer foreground notification' appears on the watch and cannot be dismissed. Turning off the notification disables all AAPS notifications on the watch.
cause: The notification was added to keep the background service running on Android 10+ so that complications work, but it results in a permanent notification that cannot be removed.
fix: As a workaround, users can disable the notification channel via the watch's developer options: App Notifications -> All watch apps -> AAPS -> Data layer Foreground Service Channel: OFF. Later dev builds may have improved the behavior.
settings_changed: Data layer Foreground Service Channel → OFF
evidence_quote: With current dev-builds, on the Samsung Galaxy Watch 4, I can hide the ongoing notification through developer menu settings on Watch: `App Notifications -> All watch apps -> AAPS -> Data layer Foreground Service Channel: OFF`
